log.message:
[native] Always retain ResourceTable TextureState

Stop special-casing ReadOnly textures for removal from mTextureState
when slots becomes empty in SetResourceUsage and SetEntry, and add a
GetOrCreateTextureState helper. Once a non-destroyed texture is added
to mTextureState (via SetEntry or SetResourceUsage), its entry and
mResourceTableUses registration are retained until either the texture
is destroyed (OnTextureDestroyed) or the table is destroyed
(DestroyImpl).

Also ignore already-destroyed textures in SetEntry so mTextureState and
SlotState::resource never hold destroyed textures, allowing IsVisible
and the backends to assert !IsDestroyed().

Note that this trades away the optimization where ReadOnly textures
with no bound slots were untracked from mTextureState and
mResourceTableUses while still alive. In typical bindless usage,
textures remain in the resource table until they are destroyed, at
which point OnTextureDestroyed cleans them up immediately.

Bug: 579994653
